in_hebrew.name: אנאבל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אנאבל הוא שם שמקורו בשילוב של שני שמות עבריים: חנה (אנא) שפירושו חן וחסד, ובאל (בל) שפירושו אלוהים. השם מתאר את הילדה כמי שמקבלת חן וחסד מאלוהים, והוא נושא משמעות עמוקה של אהבה וקבלה אלוהית.

in_greek.name: Ανναμπέλ
in_greek.meaning: Χάρις και εύνοια από τον Θεό
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ανναμπέλ προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και συνδυάζει τα ονόματα Χάνα (Αννα) που σημαίνει χάρις και εὐνοία, και Ελ (Μπέλ) που αναφέρεται στον Θεό. Το όνομα αυτό συμβολίζει την εύνοια και την αγάπη του Θεού προς την κοπέλα που το φέρει.

in_latin.name: Annabell
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Annabell derivatur ex hebraeo, combinans nomina Hannah (Anna) quae significat gratiam et favorem, et El (Bell) quod refertur ad Deum. Hoc nomen describit puellam ut quae gratiam et favorem a Deo accipit, et profundam significationem amoris et acceptationis divinae habet.

in_english.name: Annabell
in_english.meaning: Gracious, favored by God, combining Hannah and Belle
in_english.long_meaning: The name Annabell is a combination of two names: Hannah, meaning 'grace' or 'favored', and Belle, derived from Elizabeth, meaning 'God is my oath'. Together, Annabell signifies 'gracious' or 'favored by God'. It carries a rich history from biblical roots, symbolizing divine favor and love. The name has been used in Christian traditions to denote a child born with God's grace and mercy.

data.cultural_impact: The name Annabell has a rich cultural history, particularly in Western Christianity. The name Anna comes from the Hebrew name Hannah, which means "grace, favor, kindness." In the Bible, the prophetess Hannah dedicated her son, Samuel, to God after giving birth to him in what was considered a miraculous pregnancy. The name also appears in the New Testament as the name of the widow who welcomed Jesus into her home during the Last Supper. The name Bell, meanwhile, is often associated with beautiful bells or the sound of bells ringing, which may suggest joy, celebration, or a call to prayer. Together, Annabell can be seen as a name that suggests both earthly beauty and spiritual grace.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Annabell can be considered a reminder of the importance of kindness, grace, and favor in our lives. Annabell's name reflects the belief that we are all called to exhibit these qualities in our interactions with others and in the world around us. The name Bell also reminds us of the beauty and light that can be found in the world and within each of us. Annabell can be seen as a reminder to seek and share grace, kindness, and beauty in our lives as a way to honor God and inspire others.
